name: Post wall
description: A wall of small squares, like a contribution graph, fills in behind the speaker's head from the bottom up. A day counter and a big post count run up with it. At the end the count turns gold. Then the wall snaps away.
when: When you show a streak or a count: days in a row, posts made, 'I posted every day for a year'.
needs: the number of days and the number to count up to
the cut time where it starts
a cutout of the speaker (made in the steps)
